notes.title: Miss Peacock：Build v0.9.0 Update Launched

tags.bug: Fixed some instances of black screens when entering chapters;
Fixed the error of learning skills exceeding 100 points;
Fixed the status error of the auto-jump button;

tags.feature: The game now starts in full screen by default;

tags.bug: Some other ancestral bugs have been fixed overnight.

notes.title: Miss Peacock v0.8.6 - Alpha Testing Begins!
notes.content:
[h2]ːluvː Official QQ Group 831197219[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833912/b2f7edfa10a6d643d112476f900dac9eefd530b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Alpha Testing Begins![/h2]
[list]
[*] We have now started the Alpha version testing
[*] Join the official QQ group: [b]831197219[/b]
[*] Contact the administrators to get free Alpha test qualification
[*] First come, first served ːbbtcatː
[/list]

[h2]v0.8.6 Completed Content[/h2]

ːTheRedCrownː After several weeks of continuous development, we have restructured the entire save system and added some minor features. Thank you for your patience and attention.

[h3]Multiple Save Slots Feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] 80 manual save slots
[*] 10 auto-save slots
[*] Save screenshots
[/list]

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added left side popup window for displaying character status, skills, and quests
[*] Lieutenant Chen's office can now display collections and character status
[*] Fixed a bundle of bugs
[/list]

[h2]Alpha Todo List[/h2]
[list]
[*] Conduct large-scale testing and bug fixes
[*] Development of achievement system
[*] Development of dialogue log system
[/list]

[h2]Development Team[/h2]
 ːespressoː [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/otter-club]Otter Club[/url]
